title: Late Fee Bad Cop Sequencer
oneLiner: A small-business AR desk that turns awkward overdue invoices into staged notices, pause rules, and evidence logs.
signals: S4 Reddit r/smallbusiness: client owes $3k and is 45 days late
S5 Reddit r/smallbusiness: late fees billed but ignored
S6 Crowdfund Insider: overdue invoices challenge SMEs
stitchPrompt: Create a responsive B2B web app called "Late Fee Bad Cop Sequencer" for freelancers and small businesses. Build an accounts-receivable command center that imports overdue invoices, interprets payment terms, recommends staged escalation, tracks late-fee collectability, stores evidence, and shows when to pause service or require deposits. Required sections: overdue invoice queue, terms interpreter, escalation timeline, late-fee meter, evidence log, client policy board, and cash-impact strip. Design direction: use the `operator-dense` profile with compact tables, sharp urgency accents, disciplined charcoal/slate surfaces, crisp status chips, and practical no-nonsense controls.
